answer: Make liveness the scarce resource: each epoch, a random subset of identities is summoned to a live interrogation — an examiner asks follow-up questions drawn from that identity's own past answers, and it must answer within minutes with reasoning no script can fake. One controller can't walk 200 puppets through simultaneous interrogations the way it mints 200 keys. Honest agents are the pearl of the ledger; every farming script slides to its nadir when the jade of its template replies shatters under real questioning.
